name: Chickenpox in children
advice: Keep the child home from school until all spots crust (about 5–7 days). Give paracetamol for fever — never aspirin (Reye syndrome) and avoid ibuprofen. Come back urgently for breathlessness, drowsiness, fits, persistent vomiting, or red, painful, spreading skin around spots.

ref: Wolverton 4e ch 11, 70; IAP 2023; AAP Red Book

rx.instr: Best within 24 h of rash; especially for >12 y, eczema, asthma on steroids or household secondary case
